name: Education Studies
description: Open to all interested Yale students, this certificate provides an opportunity to pursue an interdisciplinary study of education to complement their major.
notes: Successful completion of the certificate is noted on transcripts.
Courses taken Credit/D/Fail may not be applied toward the certificate.
No more than two course credits may overlap with a major, simultaneous degree, or another certificate.
No course credit may be counted toward the requirements of more than two curricular programs.
Graduate and professional school courses may count with approval from the Education Studies Associate Director.
Declare on Yale Hub once enrolled in EDST 1110; by January 15 or September 15 of the final semester at the latest.

policy.sourceNote: No more than two course credits may overlap in the fulfillment of the requirements of the Education Studies Certificate or of a major, a simultaneous degree, or another certificate.

requirements.name: Prerequisite
requirements.description: Foundational education studies course counted toward the five-course total.

requirements.name: Theory and Research
requirements.description: One course in Theory and Research as approved for the certificate. See Education Studies website for area listings.

requirements.name: Policy or Pedagogy
requirements.description: One course in either Policy or Pedagogy as approved for the certificate.

requirements.name: EDST electives
requirements.description: Two Education Studies electives as approved for the certificate.
